mutant.description: ARM C. The whole order reduces to one comparison -- served bytes against the build input -- and that comparison is between two things that SHOULD be equal, so a passing arm B is unattributable on its own: it would read exactly the same if the comparator were a constant. So a COPY of the served object is mutated by flipping ONE BIT at offset 100, with the LENGTH HELD FIXED so the check cannot succeed on size alone, and the same comparator is asked again.
mutant.expected: The comparator must report MISMATCH on the mutated copy while reporting MATCH on the real one. If it reported MATCH on both, arm B's pass would be a constant wearing a measurement's clothes and this order would have proved nothing about the deploy.
mutant.observed: mutated copy -> sha256 differs from HEAD, mismatch DETECTED, length unchanged (159,687 B). Real object -> match. Both arms fire in the expected directions, so arm B's match is a measurement. Separately, ARM D carries its own per-token control in the same spirit: `rerun_recipe` is a SEALED INERT token (row S14 measured it at zero on both sides) and the arm asserts it is classified INERT and refused as evidence rather than contributing a meaningless zero -- so the census is tested for the exact failure S14 recorded.

determinism.method: Same-input repeat, twice, in-session, at the amended path: the O19-AC1 invocation exactly as the face names it, rc captured unpiped on each, and the verdict set (arm name plus PASS/FAIL/NOT-EVALUATED) diffed between the two runs. The verdict set rather than a stdout hash is the comparand for the same reason as the OS-s-18 battery: this battery prints a LastModified timestamp read from S3, so a byte hash would test the object's clock rather than the arms.
determinism.observed: run1 rc=0, 'SERVED MATCHES HEAD', 6 of 6 arms passed. run2 rc=0, identical denominator line. diff of the two verdict sets -> EMPTY. The pytest grain passed on its own separate execution.

declared_exclusions.item: Whether the newly-served runner actually READS the seam on its next fire.
declared_exclusions.reason: It will not, and that is NFRA_OUTSET-S16 rather than a defect in this deploy. ESTATE_OUTSET_SEAM_PREFIX is set nowhere in Terraform, so OUTSET_SEAM_PREFIX is None on the host and _stratum_propagation returns INSTRUMENT_UNAVAILABLE without composing a key. This order's cell is the UPLOAD -- closing the gap between HEAD and the served artifact -- and its criteria grade exactly that. Claiming the seam is live would be claiming an outcome no criterion here measures.
